name: SearchIp
description: Look up any existing PolySwarm verdict for an IP address. This action only reads: it spends no scanning quota and creates no activity on the account. To submit the IP for a fresh scan instead, use ScanIp.

ip.description: The IP address to search for

detect_threshold.description: How many malicious engine detections activate the detected branch

found.description: Whether PolySwarm has an existing, complete verdict for this IP address

sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the recorded artifact

permalink.description: Link to the PolySwarm scan result

malicious_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the IP as malicious

benign_count.description: Number of engines that flagged the IP as benign

total_count.description: Total number of engines that returned a verdict, excluding those that abstained

last_scanned.description: When PolySwarm last scanned this IP address

outputs.not detected: PolySwarm has scanned this artifact and no engine detected it
outputs.unknown: PolySwarm has never seen this artifact
